self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Day and Night in Counterpoint: every 10s the wielder cycles to the next Harmonic Movement — +36% ATK, then +240 Elemental Mastery, then +56% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Pick whichever movement the scored damage window lands in. Triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction grants a second 12s instance of the movement that is active at that moment, stacking with it (12s ICD) — the "_contrapuntal" states are that doubled value. Works off-field. The Stellar Glimmer DMG movement uses stellarglimmer_dmg_, the umbrella key covering both Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl.

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1).
